title: SSR with Apollo
description: Implement server-side rendering with Apollo Client in Next.js using getServerSideProps.

data.text: Server-side rendering fetches data on the server before sending HTML to the client. With Apollo Client, you can use `getServerSideProps` to execute queries on the server, hydrate the cache, and send the initial state to the client.

data.title: SSR with getServerSideProps
data.content: Fetch data on the server and hydrate the Apollo cache.

data.title: SSR Performance
data.text: SSR adds server-side latency. Only use SSR for pages that require fresh data on every request or need SEO optimization. For static content, prefer SSG.

data.title: SSR Key Points
points: SSR fetches data on the server before rendering.
Use for SEO-critical or frequently updated pages.
data.takeaway: SSR with Apollo Client enables fresh, SEO-friendly pages while maintaining client-side interactivity.
